name: Exposure Remediation Tracker
description: Creates tasks for MFA, password resets, domain and email hygiene, takedown requests, notification and follow-up checks. Sends no email and submits no takedown.
legal_notes: Defensive exposure assessment for yourself, a verified consenting client, or an organization you are authorized to assess. Every lookup passes the consent, provider and domain-control gates and is audited. A report that data leaked is a lead, not proof that the record exists, is accurate or is still reachable. No passwords, hashes, tokens, identity documents, card numbers or leaked records are collected, stored or shown.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: Open tasks per reported incident with practical guidance and a follow-up re-check.
capability_gaps: Nothing is sent from this application: notifications and takedown requests are tracked as tasks and carried out by a person.
instructions: Creates tasks for MFA, password resets, domain and email hygiene, takedown requests, notification and follow-up checks. Sends no email and submits no takedown.
